instruction: Stack the three blocks with different textures.

arguments.note: The blocks are on the right side. Turn the right gripper downward to approach them from above.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 31 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Finish the downward orientation before locating the grasp precisely.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Approach the dark block from above, using the wrist image to refine its position before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The dark block is centered laterally. Lower to just above its top and inspect alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The head view shows the dark block behind the current grasp point. Shift back while remaining above it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Use the observed image displacement to bring the dark block between the jaw tips, while keeping clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The dark block is between the open jaws in the wrist view. Lower toward its mid-height before grasping.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Close on the dark block and check whether it is captured before lifting.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The jaws closed fully without capturing the block. Reopen and raise slightly to correct the fore-aft alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Correct the grasp 3 cm toward the dark block's rearward position before descending again.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower at the corrected alignment to straddle the dark block.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Close the jaws at the corrected dark-block position.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The jaws stopped on the dark block. Lift it clear of the table before carrying it to the purple base block.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Carry the dark block above the purple block, which will remain as the stack foundation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The purple base is nearly centered under the carried block. Lower toward it, stopping above contact for another alignment check.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The blocks remain centered. Reduce the remaining vertical gap before the final gentle seating motion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower another four millimetres toward the purple support.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The dark block appears seated on the purple block. Open the jaws to leave the two-block stack supported.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The two-block stack remains upright after release. Raise the open hand clear before approaching the wooden block.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Move above the wooden block, keeping the hand high enough to clear the existing stack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Center over the wooden block and descend to a safe pre-grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Refine the wooden block alignment with a small rearward correction before the final descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower the centered gripper to the wooden block's grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Close around the wooden block, now centered between the jaws.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The wooden block is captured. Lift clear so the supporting stack can be inspected before the final placement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The dark block remains over the purple base but has shifted slightly rearward. Position the wooden block above its current center.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wooden block is centered over the dark block. Lower to just above the expected top-stack contact height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Bring the wooden block closer to the dark support with a short vertical motion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower four millimetres for a gentle final approach to the support.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Release the wooden block at the expected top of the two-block stack, then check stability.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The three blocks remain stacked after release. Raise the open hand vertically clear of the pile.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The pile is stable. Return the right grasp point to its starting position before restoring its orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Restore the starting wrist orientation in stages, away from the completed stack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: All three blocks are standing in one pile. Finish returning the right wrist to its original orientation; the left arm is already home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
